update_layout: Batch add/update/remove selected catalog assets. dry_run defaults true: read-only report of all bounds/overlap errors and approximate interaction reachability warnings. false applies the whole batch once, only if can_apply; preserves room/character. Re-preview after revision or body changes.

observe_home: Read fresh character-perspective sight, body/support, nearby walls and incremental action feedback. Not the spectator camera; stale/no viewer is explicit.
walk_to: Walk along a validated route to a free room position. Asynchronous; inspect observe_home/job for completion.

x.description: World position in meters; Y is up.

z.description: World position in meters; Y is up.

cancel_action: Cancel the matching current job. Seated/lying characters get up safely before completion.
set_wallpaper: Apply a catalog wallpaper to one wall or all four, preserving furniture, trim and navigation. Use plain to remove it; discover ids in get_catalog.wallpapers.
update_room: Change room dimensions/finishes. Width 4..12m, depth 4..10m, ceiling 2.4..4m. Wall fixtures follow walls; floor furniture stays put. Resizing rejects bounds/overlap and body obstruction. dry_run is read-only.
list_objects: List placed objects by category/capability, their available actions, properties and current interaction.
interact: Request an object action; inspect list_objects for availability. Pose actions are asynchronous: requested is not completed. leave gets up/exits or cancels an approach.
update_object: Change a placed object label or supported properties. Lamps support on (boolean) and brightness (0..1). Supported beds have covered (boolean); other properties are rejected.
get_presets: List the childroom and family-home templates. Applying resets furniture/room to the template, not a multi-room simulation.
apply_preset: Switch the entire room atomically to a preset. Preserves character appearance; explicitly places her at the preset spawn. dry_run defaults true; false saves. Finish current interaction first.
get_state: Read the current persisted house state and revision.
get_catalog: List supported assets, activities and explicit limitations.
set_camera: Choose room, frontal full body, face closeup, three-quarter, side, back or overhead view.
set_note: Leave a note in the room.
set_activity: idle and walk control the Canvas viewer. sit remains a legacy experimental pose, not supported by the wander viewer.
move_character: Relocate to a free spot using the same character clearance as the Canvas viewer. This is not animated pathfinding.
